name: Republic of Serbian Krajina (1991–1995)
description: A horizontal tricolour of red, blue and white — the Serbian colours — charged at the centre with the arms of the Krajina: a red shield with a white cross and four firesteels beneath a crown.
history: Prescribed by Article 6 of the constitution adopted on 19 December 1991, when the Serb-held territories of Croatia proclaimed the Republic of Serbian Krajina. The republic was overrun by Croatian forces in Operation Storm in August 1995 and its remaining territory in Eastern Slavonia was reintegrated in 1998.

features.role: crowned shield with the Serbian cross and firesteels
